paragraphs.text: Hell is a colloquial term for various unpleasant locations in the Multiverse . The word is also used as a mild swear or intensifier. "Hell" appears as a part of several compound words describing dangerous entities, such as hellkite dragons or the Hellspurs , an outlaw gang.
Early lore sources conflated hell, the Underworld, the Abyss , and the Pit (a location within the Abyss).

After summoning a Lord of the Pit and failing to feed it, Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar bargained to enter its service as a cook. Asmor spent seven years and seven days in servitude to the Dark Lord Vincent , and wrote The Underworld Cookbook during that time. On the final day of her captivity, she suggested that Vincent's domain was "one of many, many disgusting little hells." Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar's Kitchen , a playtest card from a 2024 Planechase Unknown event, depicted that hell as a plane. The underworld that Asmor visited is unrelated to Theros 's Underworld .

After the sun priest Koborah and the Demonic Tutor Illith were summoned from their homes by a planeswalker's duel, Koborah's daughter Helana helped Illith to return to hell, and recovered her father. The archduke of that hell was deposed in the aftermath of her visit. Boris Devilboon was invoked by the demons of that hell as a bogeyman.
Dominarians refer to Phyrexia as "the Machine Hell" or "the Nine Hells", and swear using the latter phrase.
The Ashmouth in Stensia is associated with the card Into the Maw of Hell . Innistrad 's demons and devils also occupy the Devils' Breach , a cave in Kessig .

Voluptara is an Innistradi demon, as was Crunchgnar before his death. Voluptara quipped that the nice parts of hell can be distinguished by the temperature of the magma. Crunchgnar hoped to torment Davriel Cane 's soul on his hearth in hell and devour it afterwards.
Toshiro Umezawa speculated that he had arrived in "the stony gray hell" after being incapacitated and awakening in cold and darkness. He swore using a similar phrase.
The Hellhole is a mining pit in Ravnica's Undercity . Judith , a prominent member of the Cult of Rakdos , owns and performs at the Hellbender , a nightclub.
Akul , a scorpion dragon from Gastal , named his Thunder Junction gang the Hellspurs .

Hellions , massive snake-like creatures, are "mighty, unpredictable, and hostile". Hellhounds are elemental dogs seen on Dominaria, Ravnica, and Zendikar . Hellkite dragons are found on those same planes, as well as Alara , Tarkir , and the Edge .
The faction mechanic for Rakdos in Dissension , hellbent , was designed to match the guild's recklessness .
